name: web-solarrechner
description: Solarrechner: stündliche Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung für Photovoltaik, Balkonkraftwerk und Speicher in Deutschland
author: casoon

scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm type-check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:solar && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:solar: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @solarrechner/web exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json

scripts-info.dev: Start the calculator in dev mode
scripts-info.build: Build the calculator (OG image, then Astro)
scripts-info.check: Lint and format check with Biome
scripts-info.check:fix: Fix Biome lint and format issues
scripts-info.test:unit: Unit tests for the build config and environment
scripts-info.test:solar: Model tests: energy balance, load profiles, financing, tariff rules, PDF report
scripts-info.test:e2e: Playwright tests against the built Worker (wrangler dev)
scripts-info.prepare: Set up the Husky git hooks
scripts-info.verify: Local gate before push: check, types, unit and model tests, build
